paragraphs: Rabbi Yehoshua HaGarsi, Rabbi Akiva’s attendant, who brought him water in prison. Rashi explains: Garsi is a place-name; another explanation is that he ground groats: Eruvin 21b. A Boethusian asked Rabbi Yehoshua HaGarsi: Shabbat 118a, end [the checked passage is at Shabbat 108a:12].
